race.comment: SWITCH HIT (4) has placed three of four starts this campaign, the latest running on hard to finish runner-up at Bordertown. Looks suited by the extra ground now and should be at top. Drawn for a soft run and expected to go close. FROSTRATION (12) was caught deep last time and posted there three deep for the trip. Not a bad run holding on for third but drawn for a soft trail here and might be over the odds. EGERTON REEF (6) continues to race well and has a senior rider off a low draw. Has to be included. SENSATIONAL RULER (3) returned from a spell last start with a nice win by 1.3 lengths over 1450m at this track. Include.
